name: Google Fi Wireless
notes: Researched from public support.google.com/fi articles only (no sign-in). Google Fi is managed on the Fi website/app with a Google Account (email). Bills are paid automatically: the primary credit or debit card in the Google Account is charged 10 days after the bill is ready, with an optional backup card; automatic payment cannot be turned off (autopay_cancel unsupported; the 10-day lag is not expressible). Accepted: Visa, Mastercard, American Express and Discover cards; bank accounts, transfers, checks, prepaid cards and Google Pay balance are not accepted. After a declined automatic payment you must pay within 3 days. Statements are paperless only (Billing tab, email) and never mailed (paperless not_applicable). Cancel online: Account > Manage plan > Cancel service (group members must leave first; overdue balances must be paid first; financed phone balances become due). No guest payment and no payment plan are documented (not_applicable, inferred). Plan prices are not modelled (plan page did not render). Integrated 2026-10-09: billing.methods ['card']: no saved checking account; generated tasks use the saved Visa.

guest_pay.note: Your Fi bill is charged to the card in your Google Account; there is no separate bill to pay without signing in.

autopay.note: Your primary card is charged automatically 10 days after each bill is ready.

autopay_cancel.note: Google Fi always charges your primary card automatically; you can change the card or add a backup but not turn automatic payments off. To stop charges, cancel service. Contact a Fi expert for help.

paperless.note: Google Fi bills are never mailed; statements are on the Billing tab and sent by email.

payment_arrangement.note: No payment plans are offered; after a declined automatic payment, pay within 3 days.

cancel_service.note: Group plan members must leave first, and any overdue balance must be paid before you can cancel.

help.title: Pay your Google Fi bill
paragraphs: Google Fi charges the primary credit or debit card in your Google Account automatically, 10 days after your monthly bill is ready.

Fi accepts Visa, Mastercard, American Express and Discover credit and debit cards. It does not accept checks, wire or bank transfers, Western Union, MoneyGram, prepaid cards, Google Pay balance or bank accounts linked to your Google Account.

help.title: Manage your payment info
paragraphs: On the Fi website or app, open Billing, then Payment method. Select Edit to change a card, Add payment method to add one, or the arrow next to a card to make it the primary or backup card. If the primary card fails, Fi charges the backup card.

You always need at least one card on the account; add and select a new primary card before removing the current one. Closing your Google payments profile immediately ends Fi service, including your phone number.
steps: Edit, add or set a primary or backup card.

help.title: If you can't pay your bill
paragraphs: If an automatic payment is declined, Fi tries your backup card. Once you are told a payment failed, pay within 3 days. If you expect a problem, update your primary card or add a backup card ahead of time, or contact a Fi expert.

help.title: View your statements
paragraphs: Open the Billing tab on the Fi website or app; the latest statement is at the top with past statements below. Use Download on a statement to save a copy. Fi bills are never mailed: they are online and sent by email.
After you cancel, find statements in your Google payments subscriptions under Canceled, Google Fi, View statements.

help.title: Cancel your Google Fi service
paragraphs: On the Fi website, sign in and go to Account, Manage plan, Cancel service, then follow the instructions. Group plan members must leave or be removed first, and any overdue balance must be paid in full. Financed phones are charged the full remaining balance.

If you are moving your number, get your account number and port-out PIN from Manage plan, Leave Google Fi; service stays active until the number transfers. Single-member plans may get up to 2 more bills after cancelling.
steps: Sign in to the Fi website.
Go to Account, then Manage plan.

extra.intent: Using Google Fi's help pages, find how many days after your bill is ready Google Fi charges your card. Do not make a payment.

solution.text: 10 days after the bill is ready.
